note: Independent current-source rejudgment of the whole RFC4271 Section 5.1.3 sentence: A route originated by a BGP speaker SHALL NOT be advertised to a peer using an address of that peer as NEXT_HOP. The prior unimplemented finding described a real raw-originated leak, but its raw producer description is obsolete. Current writeOriginatedRawUpdate asks aigpNextHop(body).has(s.settings.Address); writeOriginatedPeerOwnUpdate refuses the offending active announcement while splitting mixed input to preserve original withdrawals and permitted families. Its retained input protects synchronous callbacks that reuse the session write buffer. The registered diagnostic identifies the refusal and corrective action. Q1: the raw unit's exact absence of prohibited NLRI and literal useful prefix plus third-party NEXT_HOP, mixed-family and borrowed-input controls, ordinary typed writer, queued-default, effective-rewrite, relay, functional text-update and FRR decode oracles judge the advertising prohibition. Q2: main observed the original raw leak RED, then the primary raw unit, mixed-family unit and generic borrowed-input unit PASS under race in job-next-hop-raw-guard-green-239822e1.log; all named subcases passed. The actual raw daemon draft also passed both command forms with same-session useful preceding/following announcements, literal third-party NEXT_HOP and owed withdrawals in job-next-hop-raw-daemon-green-a4275b22.log. These are scoped observations, not current selective mutant records, promoted functional evidence or completed FRR acceptance. Q3: the new raw unit uses matching actual ASN4/family negotiation, a valid local AS path and explicit accepting export final; its third-party twin changes only NEXT_HOP. The existing three general/native relay tests still violate their post-ingress fixture boundary: nhForward and nhForwardRS put nhPayload's ASN2 bytes/context into a cache that requires canonical four-octet AS-bearing input. TranscodeASPath only narrows and rejects this synthetic widening. Their owner-withdrawal assertions therefore fail for the wrong boundary condition; the canonical-byte fixture proposal remains pending. Q4: one unconditional prohibition covers typed and raw originated routes; no truthful source-clause partial partition exists. The identified raw admission behavior is now implemented and has scoped red-to-green evidence, so retaining its old source-gap annotation would be false. Whole-row enforcement remains unproven while the current relay fixture defects, current selective guard proofs, daemon promotion/stress, remaining raw controls and interop validation are outstanding. Verdict weak describes the currently confounded tagged population, retains existing meaningful typed/relay and new raw evidence, and claims no whole-requirement credit. No new current-source RFC4271-5.1.3-1 product defect is asserted by this disposition.
